BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Commerce & Labor (originally sponsored by Senators Rivers and Hasegawa; by request of Liquor Control Board)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning marijuana, useable marijuana, and marijuana-infused products in public.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to opening a package of or consuming marijuana, useable marijuana, or marijuana-infused products in public; amending RCW 69.50.445; and prescribing penalties.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 69.50.445 and 2013 c 3 s 21 are each amended to read as follows:Opening package of or consuming marijuana, useable marijuana, or marijuana-infused product in view of general public—Penalty.
BillSection.P: (1) It is unlawful to open a package containing marijuana, useable marijuana, or a marijuana-infused products, or marijuana concentrate, or consume marijuana, useable marijuana, or a marijuana-infused products, or marijuana concentrate, in view of the general public or a public place.

P.TextRun: (2) For the purposes of this section, "public place" has the same meaning as defined in RCW 66.04.010, but the exclusions in RCW 66.04.011 do not apply.

BillSection.P: (3) A person who violates this section is guilty of a class 3 civil infraction under chapter 7.80 RCW.

AnnNote.NoteP: Intent—2013 c 3 (Initiative Measure No. 502): See note following RCW 69.50.101.
